{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_011Cdg4KQ7jEKtdaX9KuBxMW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BYbbjCzbvDxu28MNSzZGKM","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-easii1pc/project/parts/cable_clip.py","content":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef cable_clip(bundle_diameter=8.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    Screw-down cable clip that holds a cable bundle.\n\n    bundle_diameter: diameter of cable bundle in mm\n    \"\"\"\n    # Channel geometry derived from bundle size\n    channel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4  # 8.4\n    channel_depth = bundle_diameter       # 8.0\n    wall_thickness = 2.4\n    base_thickness = 3.0\n    clip_length = 12.0\n    hole_diameter = 4.2\n    tab_length = 10.0\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.union(left_wall).union(right_wall).union(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.subtract(hole)\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on all exposed edges\n    part = polish(part, 1.0)\n\n    return part\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":8,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2356,"cache_read_input_tokens":31794,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2356},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f0372a60-7ed8-44f9-ac61-3be1a1cb6c90","uuid":"cd0e9e14-f21f-4710-b3bd-eb42ba0d358c","timestamp":"2026-08-03T15:33:21.370Z","request_id":"req_011Cdg4KNU1bDC8wZU1Vd16o"}

hole","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef cable_clip(bundle_diameter=8.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    Screw-down cable clip that holds a cable bundle.\n\n    bundle_diameter: diameter of cable bundle in mm\n    \"\"\"\n    # Channel geometry derived from bundle size\n    channel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4  # 8.4\n    channel_depth = bundle_diameter       # 8.0\n    wall_thickness = 2.4\n    base_thickness = 3.0\n    clip_length = 12.0\n    hole_diameter = 4.2\n    tab_length = 10.0\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.union(left_wall).union(right_wall).union(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.subtract(hole)\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on all exposed edges\n    part = polish(part, 1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":37,"oldLines":7,"newStart":37,"newLines":7,"lines":["     tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))"," ","     # Combine all pieces into one solid","-    part = base.union(left_wall).union(right_wall).union(tab)","+    part = base | left_wall | right_wall | tab"," ","     # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)","     hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2"]},{"oldStart":47,"oldLines":7,"newStart":47,"newLines":7,"lines":["     hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))"," ","     # Subtract the hole","-    part = part.subtract(hole)","+    part = part - hole","newString":"    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.cut(hole)","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef cable_clip(bundle_diameter=8.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    Screw-down cable clip that holds a cable bundle.\n\n    bundle_diameter: diameter of cable bundle in mm\n    \"\"\"\n    # Channel geometry derived from bundle size\n    channel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4  # 8.4\n    channel_depth = bundle_diameter       # 8.0\n    wall_thickness = 2.4\n    base_thickness = 3.0\n    clip_length = 12.0\n    hole_diameter = 4.2\n    tab_length = 10.0\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base | left_wall | right_wall | tab\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part - hole\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on all exposed edges\n    part = polish(part, 1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":37,"oldLines":7,"newStart":37,"newLines":7,"lines":["     tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))"," ","     # Combine all pieces into one solid","-    part = base | left_wall | right_wall | tab","+    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)"," ","     # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)","     hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2"]},{"oldStart":47,"oldLines":7,"newStart":47,"newLines":7,"lines":["     hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))"," ","     # Subtract the hole","-    part = part - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.cut(hole)\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on all exposed edges\n    part = polish(part, 1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":49,"oldLines":7,"newStart":49,"newLines":9,"lines":["     # Subtract the hole","     part = part.cut(hole)"," ","-    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on all exposed edges","-    part = polish(part, 1.0)","+    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on exposed edges (avoid concave edges in channel)","+    concave = concave_edges(part)","+    edges_to_polish = [e for e in part.edges if e not in concave]","+    part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)"," ","     return part"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Channel geometry derived from bundle size\n    channel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4  # 8.4\n    channel_depth = bundle_diameter       # 8.0\n    wall_thickness = 2.4\n    base_thickness = 3.0\n    clip_length = 12.0\n    hole_diameter = 4.2\n    tab_length = 10.0\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.cut(hole)\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on exposed edges (avoid concave edges in channel)\n    concave = concave_edges(part)\n    edges_to_polish = [e for e in part.edges if e not in concave]\n    part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":51,"oldLines":7,"newStart":51,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ","     # Channel geometry derived from bundle size\n    channel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4  # 8.4\n    channel_depth = bundle_diameter       # 8.0\n    wall_thickness = 2.4\n    base_thickness = 3.0\n    clip_length = 12.0\n    hole_diameter = 4.2\n    tab_length = 10.0\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.cut(hole)\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on exposed edges (avoid concave edges in channel)\n    concave = concave_edges(part)\n    edges_to_polish = [e for e in part.edges() if e not in concave]\n    part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":49,"oldLines":9,"newStart":49,"newLines":20,"lines":["     # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # 18.2) ** 2 + (edge_center.Y - 6.0) ** 2) ** 0.5\n        if 1.9 < dist_to_hole_center_xy < 2.3:  # Approximately hole radius\n            hole_edges.add(edge)\n\n    # Chamfer only the outer exposed edges\n    edges_to_polish = [\n        e for e in part.edges()\n        if e not in concave and e not in bottom_edges and e not in hole_edges\n    ]\n\n    if edges_to_polish:\n        part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)\n\n    return part","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef cable_clip(bundle_diameter=8.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    Screw-down cable clip that holds a cable bundle.\n\n    bundle_diameter: diameter of cable bundle in mm\n    \"\"\"\n    # Channel geometry derived from bundle size\n    channel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4  # 8.4\n    channel_depth = bundle_diameter       # 8.0\n    wall_thickness = 2.4\n    base_thickness = 3.0\n    clip_length = 12.0\n    hole_diameter = 4.2\n    tab_length = 10.0\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.cut(hole)\n\n    # Check if we need to polish\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":49,"oldLines":5,"newStart":49,"newLines":35,"lines":["     # Subtract the hole","     part = part.cut(hole)"," ","-    # Check if we need to polish","+    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on exposed top/outer edges only","+    # Avoid: concave edges (channel interior), bottom edges (bed), and hole edges","+    concave = concave_edges(part)","+","+    # Find bottom edges (edges at Z < 0.5)","+    bottom_edges = set()","+    for edge in part.edges():","+        edge_center_z = edge.center().Z","+        if edge_center_z < 0.5:","+            bottom_edges.add(edge)","+","+    # Find hole edges (cylinder edges) - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.cut(hole)\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on exposed top/outer edges only\n    # Avoid: concave edges (channel interior), bottom edges (bed), and hole edges\n    concave = concave_edges(part)\n\n    # Find bottom edges (edges at Z < 0.5)\n    bottom_edges = set()\n    for edge in part.edges():\n        edge_center_z = edge.center().Z\n        if edge_center_z < 0.5:\n            bottom_edges.add(edge)\n\n    # Find hole edges (cylinder edges) - these are likely to cause issues\n    hole_edges = set()\n    for edge in part.edges():\n        # Cylinder edges have specific characteristics\n        # Check if edge is on or very close to the hole\n        edge_center = edge.center()\n        # Hole is centered at (18.2, 6.0, 1.5) with radius 2.1\n        dist_to_hole_center_xy = ((edge_center.X - 18.2) ** 2 + (edge_center.Y - 6.0) ** 2) ** 0.5\n        if 1.9 < dist_to_hole_center_xy < 2.3:  # Approximately hole radius\n            hole_edges.add(edge)\n\n    # Chamfer only the outer exposed edges\n    edges_to_polish = [\n        e for e in part.edges()\n        if e not in concave and e not in bottom_edges and e not in hole_edges\n    ]\n\n    if edges_to_polish:\n        part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":78,"oldLines":6,"newStart":78,"newLines":6,"lines":["     ]"," ","     if edges_to_polish:","-        part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)","+        part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 0.5)"," ","     return part"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.cut(hole)\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on exposed top/outer edges only\n    # Avoid: concave edges (channel interior), bottom edges (bed), and hole edges\n    concave = concave_edges(part)\n\n    # Find bottom edges (edges at Z < 0.5)\n    bottom_edges = set()\n    for edge in part.edges():\n        edge_center_z = edge.center().Z\n        if edge_center_z < 0.5:\n            bottom_edges.add(edge)\n\n    # Find hole edges (cylinder edges) - these are likely to cause issues\n    hole_edges = set()\n    for edge in part.edges():\n        # Cylinder edges have specific characteristics\n        # Check if edge is on or very close to the hole\n        edge_center = edge.center()\n        # Select only longer edges for chamfering (avoid creating slivers)\n    min_edge_length = 5.0  # Only chamfer edges longer than 5mm\n    edges_to_polish = [\n        e for e in part.edges()\n        if (e not in concave and e not in bottom_edges and e.length > min_edge_length)\n    ]\n\n    if edges_to_polish:\n        part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)\n\n    return part","newString":"    return part","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef cable_clip(bundle_diameter=8.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    Screw-down cable clip that holds a cable bundle.\n\n    bundle_diameter: diameter of cable bundle in mm\n    \"\"\"\n    # Channel geometry derived from bundle size\n    channel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4  # 8.4\n    channel_depth = bundle_diameter       # 8.0\n    wall_thickness = 2.4\n    base_thickness = 3.0\n    clip_length = 12.0\n    hole_diameter = 4.2\n    tab_length = 10.0\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Subtract the hole\n    part = part.cut(hole)\n\n    # Polish: 1mm chamfer on exposed edges, avoid slivers\n    # Avoid: concave edges (channel interior), bottom edges (bed)\n    concave = concave_edges(part)\n\n    # Find bottom edges (edges at Z < 0.5)\n    bottom_edges = set()\n    for edge in part.edges():\n        if edge.center().Z < 0.5:\n            bottom_edges.add(edge)\n\n    # Select only longer edges for chamfering (avoid creating slivers)\n    min_edge_length = 5.0  # Only chamfer edges longer than 5mm\n    edges_to_polish = [\n        e for e in part.edges()\n        if (e not in concave and e not in bottom_edges and e.length > min_edge_length)\n    ]\n\n    if edges_to_polish:\n        part = polish(part, edges_to_polish, 1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":49,"oldLines":24,"newStart":49,"newLines":4,"lines":["     # Overall dimensions\n20\t    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n21\t    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n22\t\n23\t    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n24\t    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n25\t    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n26\t\n27\t    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n28\t    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n29\t    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n30\t\n31\t    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n32\t    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n33\t    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n34\t\n35\t    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n36\t    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n37\t    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n38\t\n39\t    # Channel geometry derived from bundle size\n    channel_width = bundle_diameter + 0.4  # 8.4\n    channel_depth = bundle_diameter       # 8.0\n    wall_thickness = 2.4\n    base_thickness = 3.0\n    clip_length = 12.0\n    hole_diameter = 4.2\n    tab_length = 10.0\n\n    # Overall dimensions\n    channel_box_width = 2 * wall_thickness + channel_width  # 13.2\n    total_width = channel_box_width + tab_length  # 23.2\n\n    # Base (23.2 x 12.0 x 3.0): covers full footprint from Z=0\n    base = Box(total_width, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    base = base.translate((total_width / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Left wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): sits on base at Z=3.0\n    left_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    left_wall = left_wall.translate((wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Right wall (2.4 x 12.0 x 8.0): at X = channel_box_width - wall_thickness\n    right_wall = Box(wall_thickness, clip_length, channel_depth)\n    right_wall = right_wall.translate((channel_box_width - wall_thickness / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness + channel_depth / 2))\n\n    # Mounting tab (10.0 x 12.0 x 3.0): extends from right wall at same Z level as base\n    tab = Box(tab_length, clip_length, base_thickness)\n    tab = tab.translate((channel_box_width + tab_length / 2, clip_length / 2, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    # Combine all pieces into one solid\n    part = base.fuse(left_wall).fuse(right_wall).fuse(tab)\n\n    # Create through-hole in tab (4.2 mm diameter, vertical)\n    hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2\n    hole = Cylinder(hole_radius, base_thickness)\n    hole_center_x = channel_box_width + tab_length / 2\n    hole_center_y = clip_length / 2\n    hole = hole.translate((hole_center_x, hole_center_y, base_thickness / 2))\n\n    #
